summary_en: SBI Holdings, through subsidiary SBIER and SBI NM LLC, extended the tender offer period for BASE Inc. (TSE Growth, code 4477) to October 15, 2026, from the original September 30 deadline, providing 30 business days total at 340 yen per share, targeting up to 23,792,300 shares representing 20.67% ownership on an equity method basis.
title_en: Notice of Extension of Tender Offer Period for Shares of BASE Inc. (Securities Code: 4477)
translation_en_brief: SBI Holdings, Inc., through its wholly-owned subsidiary SBIER and SBI NM LLC (collectively, the 'Tender Offeror'), announced an extension of the tender offer period for BASE Inc., a company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market (code 4477). The tender offer period was extended from the original deadline of September 30, 2026, to October 15, 2026, providing a total of 30 business days for shareholders to submit their responses. The tender offer price remains 340 yen per ordinary share, with the upper limit of shares targeted for acquisition set at 23,792,300 shares, representing an expected equity ownership of 20.67% on an equity method basis following completion of the acquisition. BASE's board of directors expressed support for the tender offer while leaving the decision to participate to the discretion of shareholders. The extension was decided after consideration of shareholder subscription status and future subscription outlook, to provide shareholders with an additional opportunity to make an informed judgment regarding participation in the tender offer.
